newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas sees only five deals in "miserable" tra.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas sees only five deals in "miserable" tra.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures saw only five deals on Thursday, with just 50 lots traded over the day.
None of the monthly contracts traded more than once. April fell by 0.10 pence a therm to trade at 10.10 pence, while August, November, January and February all moved up slightly.
"It's been miserable, we've hardly seen anything today," said one futures broker, who added that "not a lot" was happening on the physical market.
The IPE natural gas contract was launched on January 31, and reached a high of 575 lots traded on February 19.
